For Delhi delivery, switching is relatively easy because these are generally month-to-month or recurring online orders rather than long contracts. Current India options I could verify:

Provider	Typical cost	Switching difficulty	Key difference
Dorje Teas	~₹399/100g	Low	Monthly or quarterly subscriptions; easy to change tea/plan. 
Dorje Teas

Makaibari	Varies by box	Low–Medium	3/6/12-month delivery options; pause/cancel by email. 
Makaibari Tea

Kadambri	₹150–₹175/100g	Very low	Loose-leaf Assam/Darjeeling; more economical, but less subscription-focused. 
Kadambri Teas

Practical switching cost: usually ₹0 in cancellation fees, but check whether a prepaid plan is refundable and whether the next shipment has already been processed.

For someone in Delhi, the main switching friction is finding an equivalent tea/quantity, not logistics. Dorje is the clearest subscription-style option; Kadambri is easiest if you want maximum flexibility rather than a formal subscription.
